'''Jim Beyer''' is a ''Star Wars'' CCG player. He finished second at the [[2006 Wisconsin State Championship]] as the highest-placed player with a 4–2 record, with Endor mains and Hunt Down dueling.<ref name="sf-10070-140535">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=140535#p140535 Official WI State Championship Post], Crazy Hermit, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (11 June 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210126023437/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=10070 Internet Archive]</ref> The winner, [[Jim Li]], asked that his Day 2 bye pass to Beyer, but [[Nick Kolnik]] answered that the Players Committee's policy did not allow byes to be passed voluntarily.<ref name="sf-10070-140704">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=140704#p140704 Official WI State Championship Post], jimli (Jim Li), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (12 June 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125165619/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t10070-start20.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sf-10070-140708">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=140708#p140708 Official WI State Championship Post], bluethrawn (Nick Kolnik), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (12 June 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125165619/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t10070-start20.html Internet Archive]</ref>
